text: 涂磊说：“我从没见过几个结婚之后，依然保持优雅的女性，但凡是全心全意为家庭付出的女人，没有几个身上不沾染一些油烟味儿，嘴上不说几句牢骚话，偶尔还有些不讲道理。
en: Lei Tu said: “I have rarely seen women who remain elegant after marriage. Any woman who devotes herself wholly to her family will almost certainly pick up a bit of cooking smoke about her, mutter a few complaints, and occasionally be a little unreasonable.

text: 生活本就现实而琐碎，和睦幸福的家庭背后，都是艰辛的付出，和现实的苟且。
en: Life is inherently practical and trivial. Behind every harmonious and happy family lie hard effort and the compromises of reality.

text: 你说漂亮的指甲怎么做事？
en: How is one to do chores with pretty nails?

text: 好看的衣服怎么抱孩子？
en: How is one to hold a child in fine clothes?

text: 那锅里还烧着饭，怎么婀娜多姿？
en: With food still cooking on the stove, how can one be graceful and poised?

text: 照顾父母，如何才能够潇洒自由？
en: Caring for one's parents, how can one be carefree and unconstrained?

text: 聪明的男人都知道，为妻难，只有愚蠢的男人，才垂涎美色，错过贤妻。
en: Clever men all know that being a wife is hard; only foolish men lust after beauty and miss a virtuous wife.

text: 人美不在衣，家美全靠妻。
en: A person's beauty lies not in their clothes; a home's beauty rests entirely on the wife.

text: 撑起一个家的，其实并不是男人，而是妻子。
en: The one who truly holds up a family is not the man, but the wife.

text: 一个家庭，因为有女人，才会有温度，因为有女人，家里才充满了烟火气。
en: A family has warmth because of its woman; because of its woman, the home is full of the breath of everyday life.

text: 一个男人最大的成功和幸福不是事业有成，钱花不完，而是娶到了一个好妻子，因为她会影响你的家庭氛围，是幸福家庭的主导，会教育你的子女，会孝顺你的父母。
en: A man's greatest success and happiness is not a thriving career or more money than he can spend, but marrying a good wife — for she shapes the atmosphere of your home, leads the happy family, educates your children, and honours your parents.

text: 秧好一半谷，妻好一半福，贤妻是一个成功男人的贵人。
en: Good seedlings mean half the grain; a good wife means half the fortune. A virtuous wife is the benefactor of a successful man.

text: 股神巴菲特说过：“男人最好的投资不是选择哪只股，而是选对妻子。
en: The stock guru Buffett once said: “A man's best investment is not which stock he picks, but choosing the right wife.

text: 正所谓：贤妻扶我青云志，我还贤妻万两金。
en: As the saying goes: a virtuous wife supports my lofty ambitions; I return to her ten thousand taels of gold.

text: 如果说人生是一个战场，那么，夫妻相助相携，一起努力才能修成正果。
en: If life is a battlefield, then husband and wife must help and support each other and strive together to reach fulfilment.

text: 妻子守护的就是大后方，只有后方稳定安宁，丈夫才能安心在前方冲锋陷阵，努力赚钱，创造财富。
en: The wife guards the home front. Only when the rear is stable and peaceful can the husband charge ahead with ease, work hard to earn money, and create wealth.

text: 生活现实而琐碎，婚前，生活全是琴棋书画诗酒花，婚后，生活都是柴米油盐酱醋茶。
en: Life is practical and trivial. Before marriage, life is all zither, chess, books, painting, poetry, wine and flowers; after marriage, life is all firewood, rice, oil, salt, sauce, vinegar and tea.

text: 婚姻中的女人，更是绕不开带娃、洗衣、做饭、刷碗、拖地.....但凡是全心全意为家庭付出的女人，没有几个身上不沾染几分烟火尘气，身上带着一些油烟味儿，嘴上说着几句牢骚话。
en: A woman in marriage cannot escape child-rearing, washing, cooking, washing up and mopping… Any woman who devotes herself wholly to her family will almost certainly pick up a bit of everyday dust and cooking smoke about her, and mutter a few complaints.

text: 做为一个女人，承受了生活的琐碎，舍弃了外表的美丽，有多付出，就有越多在意，洗衣做饭带娃是她为生活美好的努力，是她在日常琐事里为家和家人投入的一份深情和爱意。
en: As a woman, she bears the triviality of life and gives up her outward beauty. The more she gives, the more she cares. Washing, cooking and child-rearing are her efforts for a better life, her deep affection and love invested in her home and family amid everyday chores.

text: 聪明的男人不是一个情感的色盲，看不到这样女人身上的美丽，反而去嫌弃她的外表。
en: A clever man is not emotionally colour-blind; he does not fail to see the beauty of such a woman and then dislike her appearance.

text: 聪明的男人都知道，为妻难，只有愚蠢的男人，才垂涎美色，错过贤妻。
en: Clever men all know that being a wife is hard; only foolish men lust after beauty and miss a virtuous wife.

text: 男人女人之间是一种互相成就的关系，带给一个女人希望的不是爱情，而是男人的责任感；带给一个男人安全感的不是爱情，而是女人对家庭的付出。
en: The relationship between man and woman is one of mutual fulfilment. What brings a woman hope is not love, but a man's sense of responsibility; what brings a man a sense of security is not love, but a woman's devotion to the family.

text: 幸福不会从天降，要靠共同努力。
en: Happiness does not fall from the sky; it depends on joint effort.

text: 女人懂得守护家庭，理解丈夫，关爱家人，男人懂得珍惜感情，爱护妻子，欣赏妻子，彼此以诚以待，相助相携，互相支持，互相疼爱，这样的家庭，才会越来越和谐，越来越幸福。
en: When women understand how to guard the home, understand their husbands, and care for their family; when men understand how to treasure their feelings, cherish and appreciate their wives; when both treat each other with sincerity, help and support one another, and love each other dearly — such a family will grow ever more harmonious and ever happier.

text: 楼主的状态是典范，这和长期的自律，理性，善念，自醒是分不开的。
en: The original poster's state is exemplary; it is inseparable from long-term self-discipline, reason, goodwill and self-reflection.

text: 我，80后、长居深圳，比较有共鸣。
en: I am a post-80s, long resident in Shenzhen, and found it quite resonant.

text: 40+ 这个阶段的通透，真的是岁月沉淀出来的。
en: This clarity at the 40-plus stage truly comes from the sedimentation of the years.

text: 前半生为生活奔波、为孩子牵绊、为人情世故妥协，
en: In the first half of life we rush about for a living, are tied down by our children, and compromise over social niceties,

text: 熬过鸡飞狗跳的陪读岁月，扛过职场的压力拉扯，
en: endure the chaotic years of accompanying our children's studies, and withstand the pulling pressures of the workplace,

text: 终于走到**孩子渐长、父母安康、身心自由**的黄金阶段。
en: finally arriving at the golden stage of **children growing up, parents hale and hearty, and freedom of body and mind**.

text: 工作不再是谋生重担，当成日常消遣，松弛自在；
en: Work is no longer a burden of making a living, but a daily pastime — relaxed and at ease;

text: 主动精简社交，远离内耗的人和烂事，学会断舍离；
en: we take the initiative to simplify our social life, keep away from draining people and messy affairs, and learn to let go;

text: 取悦自己变成第一顺位，演唱会、旅行、独处、热爱，
en: pleasing oneself becomes the top priority — concerts, travel, solitude, passions,

text: 慢慢把生活还给自己，向内扎根，温柔自洽。
en: slowly returning life to ourselves, rooting inward, gently at peace with ourselves.

text: 五十知天命，不是认命，而是**看清生活，接纳自己**。
en: At fifty one knows the mandate of heaven — not resigning oneself to fate, but **seeing life clearly and accepting oneself**.

text: 未来的10-20年，应该是80后最舒服、最治愈的黄金时光。
en: The coming 10 to 20 years should be the most comfortable and healing golden time for the post-80s generation.

text: 愿我们所有 80 后，平安健康，身心松弛，日子温柔，万事顺遂🌿
en: May all of us post-80s be safe and healthy, relaxed in body and mind, with gentle days and all things going well 🌿

text: 前几天在知乎上看到一个很有意思的提问——
en: A few days ago I saw a rather interesting question on Zhihu —

text: “40岁有50万存款，不想卷了，能提前躺平养老吗？
en: “At 40 with 500,000 in savings, not wanting to grind anymore, can one lie flat and retire early?

text: 这个问题问得好。
en: This is a good question.

text: 先不说这笔钱多不多吧，
en: Setting aside whether this sum is large or not,

text: 躺平躺不平，哆啦觉得从经济学角度要考虑两点。
en: as to whether one can truly lie flat, Duola thinks two points must be considered from an economic perspective.

text: 一是通胀，如果有通胀，50万根本就用不了多久。
en: First, inflation: if there is inflation, 500,000 will not last long at all.

text: 二是长寿，长寿了怎么办，50万花着花着就没了~
en: Second, longevity: what if you live long? The 500,000 will be spent away before you know it~

text: 先给大家分享一个故事。
en: First, let me share a story with everyone.

text: N1
en: N1

text: 别墅和每月生活费之间的较量
en: The contest between a villa and a monthly living allowance

text: 有个90岁老太太，丈夫和儿女都去世了，只剩下孙子。
en: There was a 90-year-old lady whose husband and children had all passed away, leaving only a grandson.

text: 老太太有一套别墅，但没有养老金。
en: The old lady owned a villa but had no pension.

text: 她的邻居是个男律师，49岁。
en: Her neighbour was a male lawyer, aged 49.

text: 老太太跟律师说，只要你每月给我一笔生活费，
en: The old lady said to the lawyer, “As long as you give me a living allowance each month,

text: 我死后这套房子就送给你。
en: after I die this house will be given to you.”

text: 律师觉得划算，老太都90岁了，还能活几年呢？
en: The lawyer thought it a good deal — the old lady was already 90, how many more years could she live?

text: 于是就签了个协议，每月给老太太支付生活费。
en: So they signed an agreement: the lawyer would pay the old lady a living allowance each month.

text: 不料老太太长命百岁还非常健康，
en: Unexpectedly, the old lady lived to a hundred and remained very healthy,

text: 律师也信守承诺一直给她支付。
en: and the lawyer honoured his promise and kept paying her.

text: 后来律师扛不住，77岁离世了。
en: Later the lawyer could no longer cope and passed away at 77.

text: 临终前还嘱咐妻子，要继续给老太太支付生活费。
en: On his deathbed he told his wife to keep paying the living allowance to the old lady.

text: 没想到，老太太直接活到了122岁。
en: Unexpectedly, the old lady lived straight on to 122.

text: 这么多年来，律师夫妇总共支付了多少生活费呢？
en: Over all these years, how much living allowance did the lawyer and his wife pay in total?

text: 92万法郎，超过这栋别墅的价格好几倍了~
en: 920,000 francs — several times more than the price of the villa~

text: 举这个例子，只是想说明，别说是50万，
